flows.name: Open an attributed Mintlify training lesson
steps: Authenticate in the Project Management product
Open a cataloged docs video from the training library
Follow the product-owned attributed documentation link
flows.expectedOutcome: The product issues an opaque short-lived assertion in the docs URL fragment without sharing an application session cookie

flows.name: Record privacy-minimized video progress
steps: Remove the assertion fragment immediately on the docs page
Attach the global tracker only to a cataloged tagged video
Send a bounded versioned event without credentials or PII
flows.expectedOutcome: The canonical product endpoint validates origin, audience, expiry, lesson binding, and writes through record_video_learning_progress

claims.description: The docs origin receives only an opaque short-lived lesson-bound assertion and a minimal event payload, never application cookies or raw PII
Attributed docs video progress enters the existing learning progress RPC and reporting model without a parallel analytics store
The authenticated product lesson and both Mintlify training pages render the tagged video and attributed source action
